seo.meta_title: Smoothie King Gladiator: Protein, Calories, Flavors & Price
seo.meta_description: The Smoothie King Gladiator packs about 45 g of protein for around 220 calories with no added sugar. Flavors, sizes, price and what's in it.
seo.h1: What Is the Smoothie King Gladiator?

question: What Is the Smoothie King Gladiator?
quick_answer: The Gladiator is Smoothie King's high-protein, low-carb smoothie. Made mostly from its Gladiator protein blend, a 20 oz Gladiator Vanilla has about 45 grams of protein and 220 calories, with no added sugar. It comes in Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry, and you can add fruit or other enhancers. A 20 oz costs about $5.49 at many stores, with 32 oz and larger sizes too.
key_facts: About 45 g of protein and around 220 calories (20 oz)
0 g added sugar in the base Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry versions
Made with Smoothie King's Gladiator protein blend
Comes in 20 oz, 32 oz and a large size
Contains milk and egg; not vegan

body.heading: What the Gladiator is
body.text: The Gladiator is part of Smoothie King's Get Fit lineup, built for people who want a lot of protein without much sugar or carbs. Its main ingredient is Smoothie King's own Gladiator protein blend, and the plain versions come in Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry flavors. Many people drink it after a workout or as a quick high-protein snack.

body.heading: Protein and calories
body.text: According to Smoothie King, a 20 oz Gladiator Vanilla has 45 grams of protein, 220 calories and 0 grams of added sugar. The Strawberry version is similar, with about 1 gram of sugar. Because most of the calories come from the protein blend rather than fruit, the numbers stay close to 220 calories even in bigger sizes, unless you add fruit or other ingredients.

body.heading: Flavors and add-ons
body.text: Besides Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry, Smoothie King has made versions like Gladiator Chocolate Espresso, which adds banana and espresso and comes to about 310 calories and 46 grams of protein. You can add fruit, peanut butter or enhancers like a multivitamin or extra protein, but each addition raises calories and sugar. Smoothie King's online menu updates the nutrition label as you customize.

body.heading: Sizes and price
body.text: The Gladiator comes in 20 oz and 32 oz cups plus a large, listed as 40 oz on many menus and 44 oz on some nutrition sites. At many stores a 20 oz costs about $5.49, with larger sizes a few dollars more. Prices vary by location; see our Smoothie King menu page for typical prices.

body.heading: Allergens
body.text: Smoothie King lists egg and milk as allergens in its Gladiator protein, so the Gladiator isn't vegan or dairy-free. If you have an allergy, check Smoothie King's ingredient list for your exact order.

faqs.q: How much protein is in a Smoothie King Gladiator?
faqs.a: About 45 grams in a 20 oz Gladiator Vanilla, according to Smoothie King.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a Gladiator smoothie?
faqs.a: About 220 calories for a 20 oz Gladiator Vanilla, before any add-ins.
The base Vanilla, Chocolate and Strawberry versions have 0 grams of added sugar.

faqs.q: Is the Smoothie King Gladiator vegan?
faqs.a: No. The Gladiator protein contains egg and milk.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Gladiator come in?
faqs.a: 20 oz, 32 oz and a large (listed as 40 or 44 oz depending on the source).
